title: How to Achieve Your Most Ambitious Goals | Stephen Duneier | TEDxTucson
summary: Stephen Duneier describes a decision-making approach that took him from struggling with simple tasks to achieving ambitious goals. The talk centers on breaking goals into small marginal adjustments.
why: HN people recommend it for its simple, powerful idea of marginal adjustments and its usefulness for tackling big projects.

quote.text: The idea of marginal adjustment is both simple and powerful.
